confirmedSourceIssues.title: Authoritative manifest does not match the frontend artifact contract
confirmedSourceIssues.mechanism: Get returns the service alias of persisted Artifact directly inside data. Wire fields include byte_count and storage_kind but no status, format, bytes, storage, user_id, completed_at or error. camelCaseKeys provides byteCount/storageKind aliases, not bytes/storage/status. The hook casts without validation/adaptation, leaving four summary fields unknown and artifact.status undefined, so no download URL is produced.
confirmedSourceIssues.sourceRepro: Trace a synthetic nonnull Go Artifact through Respond, camelCaseKeys and fetchEnvelope, then evaluate the page guards: status===complete is false; bytes/storage/format are undefined; metadata ID/checksum/created/expiry survive. No server request or real artifact needed; this is source tracing, not an executed test.
confirmedSourceIssues.needs: Existing GDPR API/type integration owner must establish real manifest/job status/format/capability evidence and align hook/types/page without fabricated completion or lost manifest fields.
confirmedSourceIssues.provenance: Previously recorded in audit-page-016.json architectureIssues and requiredSharedChanges; re-confirmed unchanged, not a newly discovered independent repair campaign.

confirmedSourceIssues.title: Metadata lookup interpolates the editable ID without path encoding
confirmedSourceIssues.mechanism: Lookup accepts any nonblank ID. Metadata request inserts it raw into the path, while the download correctly encodes its path segment. Reserved characters can change route, query or fragment meaning.
confirmedSourceIssues.sourceRepro: Use synthetic draft 'qa?marker=1' or 'qa#suffix': the request string is a different route/query/fragment interpretation, not one encoded ID segment. No request was issued; no assumption of UUID-only server validation.
confirmedSourceIssues.needs: Encode the metadata path segment or validate the authoritative ID contract, retaining URL-driven selection and an honest invalid-ID result.

confirmedSourceIssues.title: Terminal-state polling disagrees with page/hook copy
confirmedSourceIssues.mechanism: enabled is Boolean(id) and refetchInterval is always FAST=10000 while mounted/foreground. No complete/failed/expired cutoff exists despite queued/running-only documentation.
confirmedSourceIssues.sourceRepro: Follow any nonblank selected ID with terminal status through unchanged hook options; interval remains 10s. No timer/test rerun performed.
confirmedSourceIssues.needs: Reconcile documented polling lifecycle with the existing query owner; do not silently change accepted polling policy while fixing the manifest.

confirmedSourceIssues.title: Initial paused lookup falls into misleading download-failure copy
confirmedSourceIssues.mechanism: An enabled initial query with fetchStatus paused has no data/error and isLoading false. DataState exposes isRefreshBlocked but page only supplies dataSources when hasData. The summary says Source not loaded; details/lifecycle show empty prompts and download says No bundle available — see the error above although no artifact failure/error exists.
confirmedSourceIssues.sourceRepro: Reason from a synthetic initial paused query: activeId nonblank, data undefined, error null, isPending true, isLoading/isFetching false, fetchStatus paused. Follow these explicit branches; no browser or simulated mounted test executed.
confirmedSourceIssues.needs: Preserve lookup/panel shells and explicitly describe initial paused/offline/pending download state rather than failed export; retain the correctly handled retained-pause path.
confirmedSourceIssues.provenance: New bounded source finding relative to original inventory. Global shell offline indicators are outside this local finding; no claim they are absent.

confirmedSourceIssues.title: Dynamic artifact status translations are absent
confirmedSourceIssues.mechanism: All five admin.gdprExport.status.{queued,running,complete,failed,expired} keys are missing in canonical and inspected runtime English bundle. The dynamic call falls back to the raw enum; the 59 successful literal-key checks cannot detect this.
confirmedSourceIssues.sourceRepro: Supply any synthetic declared status to the t() template and inspect both English resource subtrees: no status object exists. Runtime localization in other languages was not exercised.
confirmedSourceIssues.needs: Existing catalog owner should integrate the five real status labels with normal projection tooling after API status ownership is resolved; no catalog was edited.
confirmedSourceIssues.provenance: New scoped catalog/source finding; does not imply a broader translation campaign.

confirmedSourceIssues.title: Shared relative dates report future expiry as just now and emit English
confirmedSourceIssues.mechanism: Future timestamps give negative seconds, satisfying seconds<60 and returning literal just now. Past relative labels are also literal English. Absolute helper defaults to browser locale/timezone when callers omit options; saved-preference equivalence remains unverified.
confirmedSourceIssues.sourceRepro: Choose a synthetic expiry one hour ahead of the clock and follow diff=now-expiry: negative seconds return just now rather than future-relative text. No helper execution/test rerun performed.
confirmedSourceIssues.needs: Bounded shared date owner correction for past/future localization, retaining raw ISO/absolute evidence and existing preference policy; no feature-local formatter.

confirmedSourceIssues.title: Lifecycle accessible bounds use reversed chronology
confirmedSourceIssues.mechanism: Caller creates created-first, then completed/failed, then expiry entries but omits chronology and label. Timeline defaults newest-first and infers start from last entry/end from first.
confirmedSourceIssues.sourceRepro: Trace synthetic created/completed/expiry entries into Timeline: inferred start is expiry, end is created. Exact screen-reader speech/native AX tree NOTRUN.
confirmedSourceIssues.needs: Use existing oldest-first or explicit authoritative summaryBounds and localized lifecycle label; retain event order and all timestamps.

confirmedSourceIssues.title: Metadata definition list has no dt/dd terms or definitions
confirmedSourceIssues.mechanism: dl children resolve to MetaRow div wrappers containing Caption spans and value divs, not dt/dd pairs. Styling does not provide definition-list relationships.
confirmedSourceIssues.sourceRepro: Resolve MetaRow and Caption defaults for one ID row: dl > div > span + div; executed source grep finds dl but no dt or dd. No native screen-reader claim.
confirmedSourceIssues.needs: Preserve existing styling/copy controls while using semantic dt/dd through existing typography as props or suitable semantic elements.

confirmedSourceIssues.title: Clipboard failures receive no page-visible recovery feedback
confirmedSourceIssues.mechanism: Both callers omit withToast and onCopyError. On clipboard rejection shared CopyButton logs, sets copied false and invokes no visible feedback path. Success feedback is correctly implemented, so failure is not mistaken for success but is silent to the user.
confirmedSourceIssues.sourceRepro: Follow the existing clipboard rejection catch with these exact caller props; no toast or caller error action runs. No clipboard operation performed.
confirmedSourceIssues.needs: Use existing feedback/manual-copy recovery props, without changing copied text or success announcements.

Retained complete snapshots preserve the link even when expiry passes. This secondary problem uses the intended TS shape; the actual manifest is already blocked by F01.

confirmedSourceIssues.mechanism: UI states the download counter is logged to the audit ledger. After io.Copy, handler discards RecordDownload error; service calls it best effort, and inspected repository updates counter/timestamp. Successful streaming does not prove any durable audit entry or even a persisted counter.
confirmedSourceIssues.sourceRepro: Follow existing handler with successful io.Copy and synthetic RecordDownload repository error: error is discarded; UI copy/href provides no contrary outcome. No request or storage/audit mutation executed.
